cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; the 2021 law reported in 2025 is not said to cover state data.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 60: a rule must include government or state data): the 2025 report of a 2021 law (MAR-002) names sensitive data without saying it is the state's, and Law 05-20 (MAR-001) is older than the window. The draft 2027 finance bill plans a sovereign data centre for the state's strategic data (MAR-009, MAR-010), so stage 2.
